name: lecture-notes
description: Turn lecture slides and transcripts into complete living notes and maintain the canonical Master Note in Google Docs.

interface.shortDescription: Living lecture notes in Google Docs
interface.longDescription: Create complete, readable Master Notes from lecture slides and transcripts, save them as editable Google Docs, then keep improving the same note through questions, targeted rewrites, coverage checks, and Google Docs comments.
capabilities: Create editable Google Docs Master Notes
Create notes from slides and lecture transcripts
Preserve formulas, proofs, examples, and instructor additions
Refine a Master Note without appending duplicate explanations
Read and process Google Docs comments
defaultPrompt: Create an editable Google Docs Master Note from my uploaded slides and transcript.
Check my current Google Docs Master Note against the slides and transcript for missing knowledge points.
Process my unresolved Google Docs comments for this lecture note.
